contradictions.description: Skybox's current Austin location page lists PowerCampus Austin as up to 400 MW critical load and 1,280,000 SF, while Skybox brochure PDFs market 600 MW and 3,880,000 SF/total-load design. data.json capacity_mw uses the current critical-load page; brochure figures remain in capacity_notes.
